The '''Iskallon system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Iskadrell]], the homeworld of the [[Iskalloni]].
